import os  # R472: os.replace is atomic within one filesystem

    def _persist(self, name: str, obj: Any):
        p = self.out / name
        # R472/R484: stage into a .tmp sibling, then os.replace onto the target
        # so a concurrent durable snapshot can never read a torn JSON file.
        tmp = p.parent / (p.name + ".tmp")
        tmp.write_text(json.dumps(obj, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False, default=str))
        os.replace(tmp, p)

import os
import threading  # R472: no new imports beyond threading and os

        engine = self._build_engine(session_id)
        # R484: the attempt-4 worker died mid-engine-run and the run dir never
        # reached the durable branch — loop-closure evidence died with the
        # container. Bounded checkpoint timer keeps the branch observable.
        interval = max(60, int(os.environ.get("ENGINE_DURABLE_CHECKPOINT_S", "600")))
        _ckpt_stop = threading.Event()

        def _checkpoint_loop() -> None:
            while not _ckpt_stop.wait(interval):
                _snapshot(session_id, f"engine_checkpoint:{session_id}")

        threading.Thread(target=_checkpoint_loop, daemon=True).start()
        _engine_error: BaseException | None = None
        try:
            engine.run()
        except BaseException as exc:
            _engine_error = exc
            _snapshot(session_id, f"engine_run_error:{session_id}")  # existing ERROR_RUN path
        finally:
            _ckpt_stop.set()  # every exit path — return or exception — stops the timer
        if _engine_error is None:
            _snapshot(session_id, f"engine:returned:{session_id}")
